notes: VAT 16% from Jan 2026 (new Tax Code); investment gold (bars 995+, coins 900+) exempt. Duty 10% is EAEU HS 7113 jewellery; bullion subcodes unverified. NBK Mint bars 5-100g are priced per gram flat, so no size premium. Opened packaging costs a 3% examination fee on buyback (spread not published). Used 2.2% is pawn valuation vs NBK accounting price 27 Nov 2026 (calculated). Making not found.
